sample_mapping_evidence: Primary PMID36941274 explicitly describes one patient and public processed RNA data via parentGSE216763; source216762 provides two post-pembro blood RNA matrices. Restricted raw sequencing not requested. Repeated visits share donor; sorted non-naive CD8 restriction retained.

source_processing: Both RNA and TCR libraries were processed using the CellRanger workflow (v6.1.1)

For RNA libraries, BCL files from the sequencing output were used to generate FASTQ files using the cellranger mkfastq command. Reads were then aligned to a reference (GRCh38), filtered, and counts of barcodes and UMIs were generated using the cellranger count command.

For TCR libraries, BCL files were also used to generate FASTQ files using cellranger mkfastq, as above. Reads were then aligned to a TCR reference (vdj-GRCh38), productive contigs were filtered, and CDR3 regions were identified for each cell. Cells with the same V(D)J transcripts were then grouped into the same clonotype.
Supplementary files format and content: filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 files provide feature-barcode matrices for cell-associated barcodes
Supplementary files format and content: filtered_contig_annotations.csv files provide the TCR information identified for each high-confidence contig for cell-associated barcodes

title: NonnaiveCD8, Post-pembro1, scRNAseq
characteristics_ch1: cell type: Non-naive CD8 T cells
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were thawed, and viable/CD3+/CD8+/non-[CD45RA+;CCR7+] cells were sorted. Cells were then encapsulated in oil droplets, and RNA was reverse-transcribed and amplified, according to the 10X Genomics protocol for 5' barcoded GEX and V(D)J TCR.
Libraries were prepared according to the 10X Genomics protocol for 5' barcoded GEX and V(D)J TCR.
